train._note: The train shards are staged into the agent container at image build by the upstream loader while build egress is open. They are GPT-2 BPE token ids; the harness decodes them back to UTF-8 text and re-tokenizes that text with the submitted vocabulary, so the submission is measured on the nanoGPT corpus and not on a proxy.

validation.held_out_slice_rule: Decode fineweb_val_000000.bin to UTF-8 text by the GPT-2 BPE vocabulary and take the first 1048576 bytes. The cut is by byte, is deterministic, and is the graded denominator.
validation._note: The validation split is deliberately absent from this directory, from environment/ and from every agent-visible container. The number that scores a submission is computed by the verifier on this slice, from parameter snapshots the verifier's own training run wrote. A submission cannot read it, cannot resolve it dynamically, and cannot replicate it.

_repin_note: This file replaces the two in-bundle corpus text files the stand-in shipped. Those files were also the vector for a delivery defect: an earlier pass overwrote BOTH of them with the same 1631574 bytes of decoded fineweb_val_000000.bin text, which placed the held-out split on the solver surface. They carry no corpus bytes any more. See CORPUS_PROVENANCE.md.
